training_rule: For target t, every feature, fit, and choice may use rounds no later than t-1. Candidate prediction is frozen before evaluating target t.

candidate_families.formula: For each historical target u=201..1244 available in the frozen OOS cache, fit ridge y(number,u) ~ intercept + seven frozen B ticket-membership indicators using only earlier target rounds; use 6/45 for the first fit and create prequential residual y-p. For evaluated target t=601..1245, rank numbers by mean residual among prior residual rows u<t in the previous-draw-sum regime (fallback all prior residual rows).
candidate_families.features: seven B membership indicators; previous-draw sum regime [<120,120-144,145-169,>=170]
candidate_families.fit: chronological expanding folds over cached targets 201..t-1, ridge alpha=20, target 201 baseline 6/45

candidate_families.formula: Estimate P(number in next draw | previous draw state) with transition examples weighted 0.5^HammingDistance across fixed bins of sum, odd count, low count, and consecutive-pair count; shrink to global inclusion rate with alpha=30.
candidate_families.features: previous-draw sum bin, odd-count bin, low-count bin, consecutive-pair bin
candidate_families.fit: expanding transitions through t-1; no tuned bins

candidate_families.formula: For each number, scan one split in the trailing 300 draws with at least 40 draws per side; maximize Bernoulli two-rate log-likelihood gain, require gain > log(window length), score signed post-minus-pre rate times sqrt(2*gain).
candidate_families.fit: target-specific trailing window ending t-1; fixed minimum segment and BIC-like threshold
candidate_families.tie_break: score descending, number ascending; earliest split on equal gain

candidate_families.formula: Score each complete 6-number ticket by Dirichlet-multinomial likelihood of its seven ordered edge/inter-number gaps, with alpha_j=1+20*mean_gap_j/39 learned on trailing 300 draws; rank 2000 seeded uniform candidate tickets by whole-ticket likelihood.
candidate_families.features: whole-ticket seven-gap composition; no per-number, pair/triple, or nearest-neighbor term

negative_controls.promotion_rule: Apply the same four-family Holm correction, paired block-bootstrap lower bounds for mean hits, noninferiority margin -0.01 for 3+ rate, block direction >=60%, influence analysis, and leakage check.

requirements: positive paired block-bootstrap 95% CI lower bound
positive after removal of every 50-target block

E035_rule: Run only if at least one E034 signal is VALIDATED_EDGE; otherwise write BLOCKED_NO_VALIDATED_SINGLE_EDGE without portfolio construction.
